name: fortress-react
description: Fortress desktop and web app — company sites, mall, and fabrication quotes.
author: Fortress

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n web,vision,app -c cyan,magenta,green "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort --port 5173" "node server/index.js" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.electron:build:portable: cross-env ELECTRON=1 vite build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build:native && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build:native && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:native && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:unix: npm run build:native && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync ios
